subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than 90 to
guide_solution: Summary : E-mail is the best way of communication in the present world. It is an electronic mail which works through a network of computers linked by the Interent. Its work is to exchange digital text messages from a sender to one or multiple recipients. It works instantly with just a click of the mouse. If the recipient is not online, the message will be stored in his digital mailbox. However, for its easy and instant service it has become popular and necessary like a cup of tea/coffee in the morning.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Shaheed Bir Uttam Lt. Anwar Girls' College, Dhaka. Sl. No. 36; Page No. 87
